title: Sparse and windowed attention
hook: Limit who attends to whom. Cost falls from tokens squared to tokens times a constant, and reach is what you pay with.

verified.claim: window_partition pads and reshapes into windows, and the lab's rule matched it on a CPU.
The SeedVR window function offsets windows by a half.
Fixed windows stay at 64 tokens and shifted ones reach 1024 by layer 8.
Titles from the arXiv API; these replace the draft's wrong Longformer and Trellis citations.
attention_sub_quad calls efficient_dot_product_attention from sub_quadratic_attention.py, a memory-saving computation of the same attention.
In wan/model.py window_size is stored and passed along, and no attention code reads it.

unchecked: The graph is a stand-in for 3D data. Hunyuan3D 2 may not use sparse tokens. It is shown so that you can see where 3D models sit, nothing more.
We did not run a real windowed model.
